literal: In the fifth month, on dinghai day, Didougan, the Khitan, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dinghai day, Didougan, the Khitan, and other states all sent envoys bearing tribute.

literal: On dingwei day he campaigned north against the Rouran and broke them utterly.
idiomatic: On dingwei day the emperor marched north against the Rouran and shattered them.

literal: In the sixth month the Rouran led their tribes east in migration, intending to invade south.
idiomatic: In the sixth month the Rouran moved their tribes eastward, preparing to strike south.

literal: The emperor led light cavalry to intercept them below Golden Mountain; the Rouran heard and fled far away.
idiomatic: The emperor led light cavalry to intercept them below Golden Mountain; the Rouran heard of it and fled deep into the steppe.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuzi day, Sushen sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuzi day, Sushen sent envoys bearing tribute.

literal: On renchen day criminals were pardoned.
idiomatic: On renchen day the emperor pardoned criminals.

literal: On gengxu day the emperor returned from the northern campaign.
idiomatic: On gengxu day the emperor returned from the northern campaign.

literal: In the eighth month, on dingsi day, the Turks sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingsi day, the Turks sent envoys bearing tribute.

literal: On gengzi day Prince of Qinghe Yue, Inspector of Sizhou, was made Grand Tutor; Wei Can, Minister of Works, was made Minister over the Masses; Houmochen Xiang, Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, was made Minister of Works; Prince of Pingyang Yan, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing; Prince of Changshan Yan was made Director of the Masters of Writing; Prince of Shangdang Huan, Director of the Secretariat, was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: On gengzi day Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue, Inspector of Sizhou, was made Grand Tutor; Wei Can, Minister of Works, became Minister over the Masses; Houmochen Xiang, Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, became Minister of Works; Prince of Pingyang Gao Yan, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing; Prince of Changshan Gao Yan became Director of the Masters of Writing; Prince of Shangdang Gao Huan, Director of the Secretariat, became Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

literal: On yihai day Protocol Equal to Three Imperator Yuan Xu was granted death for his crime.
idiomatic: On yihai day Yuan Xu, Protocol Equal to Three Imperator, was sentenced to death for his crimes.

literal: On dingchou day the emperor visited Jinyang.
idiomatic: On dingchou day the emperor went to Jinyang.

literal: On jimao day Gao Longzhi, Prince of Pingyuan, Opener of a Government Office Equal in Protocol to Three Imperator, and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, died.
idiomatic: On jimao day Gao Longzhi, Prince of Pingyuan, Opener of a Government Office Equal in Protocol to Three Imperator and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, died.

literal: That month an edict ordered Prince of Changshan Yan, Prince of Shangdang Huan, Prince of Qinghe Yue, Prince of Pingyuan Duan Shao, and others to lead troops and build Fa'e Fort, New Fort, Yan Fort, and Henan Fort southwest of Luoyang.
idiomatic: That month the emperor ordered Prince of Changshan Gao Yan, Prince of Shangdang Gao Huan, Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue, Prince of Pingyuan Duan Shao, and others to lead troops and build Fa'e Fort, New Fort, Yan Fort, and Henan Fort southwest of Luoyang.

literal: In the ninth month the emperor personally went there, intending to lure out the Zhou army.
idiomatic: In the ninth month the emperor went in person, hoping to draw the Northern Zhou army out.

literal: The Zhou army did not come out, and he then went to Jinyang.
idiomatic: The Zhou army did not emerge, and he then proceeded to Jinyang.

literal: In the tenth month of winter Western Wei attacked Emperor Yuan of Liang at Jiangling.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Western Wei attacked Emperor Yuan of Liang at Jiangling.

literal: An edict ordered Prince of Qinghe Yue, Prince of Hedong Pan Xiangyue, Prince of Pingyuan Duan Shao, and others to lead troops to rescue him; before they arrived Jiangling fell, and Emperor Yuan of Liang was killed by the Western Wei general Yu Jin.
idiomatic: The emperor ordered Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue, Prince of Hedong Pan Xiangyue, Prince of Pingyuan Duan Shao, and others to march to his relief; before they arrived Jiangling fell, and Emperor Yuan of Liang was killed by the Western Wei general Yu Jin.

literal: The Liang general Wang Sengbian was at Jiankang; together they raised Prince Jin'an Xiao Fangzhi as Grand Preceptor and Commander-in-Chief of All Armies at Home and Abroad, and by provisional authority appointed the full roster of officials.
idiomatic: At Jiankang the Liang general Wang Sengbian and his allies raised Prince Jin'an Xiao Fangzhi as Grand Preceptor and Commander-in-Chief of All Armies at Home and Abroad, provisionally appointing the full roster of officials.

literal: In the twelfth month, on gengshen day, the emperor toured north to Dasu Ridge, surveyed the mountains and rivers for strategic points, and planned to raise the Great Wall.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengshen day, the emperor toured north to Dasu Ridge, studied the terrain's strengths, and planned to build the Great Wall.

literal: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, on renyin day, Prince of Qinghe Yue led the host across the river and took Xiashou.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, on renyin day, Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue led the army across the Yangzi and took Xiashou.

literal: They sent back Lu Fahuo, Inspector of Ying Province of Liang.
idiomatic: They sent back Lu Fahuo, Liang Inspector of Ying Province.

literal: An edict made Xiao Ming, Attendant Cavalier in Ordinary of Liang and Marquis of Zhenyang, ruler of Liang, and dispatched Prince of Shangdang Huan, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, to lead troops and escort him.
idiomatic: The emperor made Xiao Ming, Attendant Cavalier in Ordinary of Liang and Marquis of Zhenyang, ruler of Liang, and sent Prince of Shangdang Gao Huan, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, to escort him with an army.

literal: In the second month, on jiazi day, Lu Fahuo was made Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Commander of the Military Affairs of the Ten Provinces of Jing, Yong, Jiang, Ba, Liang, Yi, Xiang, Wan, Jiao, and Guang, Grand Commandant, Grand Commander, and Grand Mobile Headquarters of the Southwestern Circuit; Song Chi of Liang, General Who Pacifies the North, Palace Attendant, and Inspector of Jing Province, was made Bearer of the Staff of Authority and General of Agile Cavalry and Inspector of Ying Province.
idiomatic: In the second month, on jiazi day, Lu Fahuo was made Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Commander of Military Affairs for ten provinces, Grand Commandant, Grand Commander, and Grand Mobile Headquarters of the Southwestern Circuit; Song Chi of Liang, General Who Pacifies the North, Palace Attendant, and Inspector of Jing Province, was made Bearer of the Staff of Authority, General of Agile Cavalry, and Inspector of Ying Province.

literal: On jiaxu day Prince of Shangdang Huan took Qiao Commandery.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day Prince of Shangdang Gao Huan took Qiao Commandery.

literal: In the third month, on bingxu day, Prince of Shangdang Huan took Dongguan, beheaded the Liang general Pei Zhiheng, and captured and killed several thousand.
idiomatic: In the third month, on bingxu day, Prince of Shangdang Gao Huan took Dongguan, beheaded the Liang general Pei Zhiheng, and captured and killed several thousand men.

literal: On bingshen day the emperor returned from Jinyang.
idiomatic: On bingshen day the emperor returned from Jinyang.

literal: The late Shizong's two sons Xiaohang and Yanzong were enfeoffed as Prince of Guangning and Prince of Ande.
idiomatic: The late Shizong's two sons Gao Xiaohang and Gao Yanzong were enfeoffed as Prince of Guangning and Prince of Ande.

literal: On wuxu day the emperor attended at Zhaoyang Hall to hear cases and decide lawsuits.
idiomatic: On wuxu day the emperor presided at Zhaoyang Hall to hear cases and pass judgment.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengshen day, the emperor went to Jinyang.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengshen day, the emperor went to Jinyang.

literal: On dingmao day Xiao Gui, Protocol Equal, took Jinxi Fort of Liang and made it Jiang Province.
idiomatic: On dingmao day Xiao Gui, Protocol Equal, took Liang's Jinxi Fort and made it Jiang Province.

literal: On wuyin day the Turks sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On wuyin day the Turks sent envoys bearing tribute.

literal: The Liang rebel Li Shanhua styled himself Son of Heaven and pressed Lu Mountain Fort.
idiomatic: The Liang rebel Li Shanhua declared himself Son of Heaven and besieged Lu Mountain Fort.

literal: In the fifth month, on yiyou day, Li Zhongkan of Zhen Fort attacked and beheaded him.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yiyou day, Li Zhongkan of Zhen Fort attacked and beheaded him.

literal: On gengyin day the emperor returned from Jinyang.
idiomatic: On gengyin day the emperor returned from Jinyang.

literal: Xiao Ming entered Jianye.
idiomatic: Xiao Ming entered Jianye.

literal: On dingwei day the Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On dingwei day the Rouran sent envoys bearing tribute.

literal: In the sixth month, on renzi day, an edict said: "Liang has met calamity; its lord is dead and its ministers scattered; yonder in the fiery south, thorns grow everywhere.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renzi day, an edict proclaimed: "Liang has met calamity; its lord is dead and its ministers scattered; in that scorched southland thorns grow everywhere.

literal: To restore what is fallen and continue what is broken — the duty lies with us; we received the elder lord and rescued them from peril and ruin; we have now sent back the ruler of Liang, and he has entered Jinling.
idiomatic: To restore the fallen and continue the broken line is our duty; we installed a senior lord and rescued Liang from peril; the ruler of Liang we escorted has now entered Jinling.

literal: The rites between vassal and liege are now in order, and the bonds of shared duty run deep.
idiomatic: The rites between vassal and liege are restored, and the bonds of shared duty run deep.

literal: Does the southern-branch bird forget its southern bough? All who are subjects of Liang should be allowed to return home and be sent off with proper ceremony.
idiomatic: Does the bird that nests in the south forget its southern bough? All subjects of Liang should be permitted to return home and be sent off with due ceremony.

literal: " On dingmao day the emperor went to Jinyang.
idiomatic: " On dingmao day the emperor went to Jinyang.

literal: On renshen day he personally campaigned against the Rouran.
idiomatic: On renshen day he personally marched against the Rouran.

literal: On jiaxu day the armies assembled at Qilian Pool.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day the armies assembled at Qilian Pool.

literal: On yihai day they went beyond the frontier to Shedi Valley; within more than a hundred li there was no spring, and the six armies were parched; then suddenly great rain fell.
idiomatic: On yihai day they crossed the frontier to Shedi Valley; for more than a hundred li there was no water, and the six armies thirsted; then suddenly a great rain fell.

literal: On wuyin day the ruler of Liang Xiao Ming sent his son Zhang, Concurrent Palace Attendant Yuan Bi, and Concurrent Attendant Cavalier in Ordinary Yang Yu to submit a memorial and pay tribute.
idiomatic: On wuyin day the ruler of Liang Xiao Ming sent his son Zhang, Concurrent Palace Attendant Yuan Bi, and Concurrent Attendant Cavalier in Ordinary Yang Yu to submit a memorial and pay tribute.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jimao day, the emperor halted at White Road, left the baggage train, and personally led five thousand light cavalry in pursuit of the Rouran.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jimao day, the emperor halted at White Road, left the baggage train behind, and personally led five thousand light cavalry in pursuit of the Rouran.

literal: On renwu day he reached Huaishuo garrison.
idiomatic: On renwu day he reached Huaishuo garrison.

literal: The emperor himself faced arrows and stones, repeatedly broke them utterly, and pressed on to Woye; he captured their chieftains Aiyanlou A'di, Tutoufa Yujiulü Zhuangyan, and others, more than twenty thousand persons in all, and several hundred thousand head of cattle and sheep.
idiomatic: The emperor himself faced arrows and stones, repeatedly shattered the enemy, and pressed on to Woye; he captured their chieftains Aiyanlou A'di, Tutoufa Yujiulü Zhuangyan, and others—more than twenty thousand captives in all—and several hundred thousand head of cattle and sheep.

literal: The Rouran chieftain Yujiulü Lijia Ti led several hundred of his tribesmen in surrender.
idiomatic: The Rouran chieftain Yujiulü Lijia Ti led several hundred of his tribesmen in surrender.

literal: On renchen day the emperor returned to Jinyang.
idiomatic: On renchen day the emperor returned to Jinyang.

literal: In the ninth month, on yimao day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yimao day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

literal: In the tenth month of winter the Liang general Chen Baxian attacked Wang Sengbian, killed him, deposed Xiao Ming, and restored Xiao Fangzhi as ruler.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter the Liang general Chen Baxian attacked Wang Sengbian, killed him, deposed Xiao Ming, and restored Xiao Fangzhi as ruler.

literal: On xinhai day the emperor went to Jinyang.
idiomatic: On xinhai day the emperor went to Jinyang.

literal: In the eleventh month, on bingxu day, Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingxu day, Goguryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.

literal: The Liang Inspector of Qin Province Xu Sihui, Inspector of South Yuzhou Ren Yue, and others seized and held Shitou Fort, and submitted their provinces to our rule.
idiomatic: Liang's Qin Inspector Xu Sihui, South Yuzhou Inspector Ren Yue, and others seized Shitou Fort and submitted their provinces to our rule.

literal: On renchen day Grand Commander Xiao Gui led troops to the river and dispatched Commander Liu Daimo and others to cross the river and hold Shitou.
idiomatic: On renchen day Grand Commander Xiao Gui led troops to the Yangzi and sent Commander Liu Daimo and others across the river to hold Shitou.

literal: Zhao Yanshen, Grand Mobile Headquarters of the Southeastern Circuit, took five commanderies including Qin, more than twenty thousand households, and settled them where they were.
idiomatic: Zhao Yanshen, Grand Mobile Headquarters of the Southeastern Circuit, took five commanderies including Qin, more than twenty thousand households, and settled the people where they were.

literal: On jihai day Grand Tutor, Inspector of Sizhou, Prince of Qinghe Yue, died.
idiomatic: On jihai day Grand Tutor and Sizhou Inspector Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue died.

literal: That month Liu Daimo, pressed by Baxian's attack, surrendered Shitou.
idiomatic: That month Liu Daimo, hard pressed by Chen Baxian's attack, surrendered Shitou.

literal: In the twelfth month, on wushen day, the Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wushen day, the Kumo Xi sent envoys bearing tribute.

literal: That year corvée labor of 1,800,000 men was levied to build the Great Wall, more than nine hundred li from Beixia Pass in You Province to Heng Province.
idiomatic: That year 1,800,000 corvée laborers were levied to build the Great Wall, more than nine hundred li from Beixia Pass in You Province to Heng Province.

literal: In the first month of spring of the seventh year, on jiachen day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the seventh year, on jiachen day, the emperor returned from Jinyang.

literal: At mounted archery west of Ye city he gathered the common people in great numbers to watch.
idiomatic: West of Ye he held mounted archery and gathered a great crowd of common people to watch.

literal: In the second month, on xinwei day, an edict ordered Prince of Changshan Yan and others to read memorials and reports on the Documents at Liangfeng Hall, discuss and settle what was right and wrong, and the emperor decided in person.
idiomatic: In the second month, on xinwei day, the emperor ordered Prince of Changshan Gao Yan and others to read memorials and reports on the Documents at Liangfeng Hall, debate their merits, and decide the matter himself.

literal: In the third month, on dingyou day, Grand Commander Xiao Gui and others led troops across the river.
idiomatic: In the third month, on dingyou day, Grand Commander Xiao Gui and others led troops across the Yangzi.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on yichou day, Lou Rui, Protocol Equal, led troops against the Luyang barbarians and broke them utterly.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yichou day, Lou Rui, Protocol Equal, led troops against the Luyang barbarians and shattered them.

literal: On dingmao day an edict ordered the building of Jinhua Hall.
idiomatic: On dingmao day an edict ordered the building of Jinhua Hall.

literal: In the fifth month, on bingshen day, Prince of Hanyang Qia died.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingshen day, Prince of Hanyang Gao Qia died.

literal: That month the emperor broke his vow of compassion regarding meat and thereafter ate no more of it.
idiomatic: That month the emperor broke his vow against meat and thereafter ate no meat at all.

literal: In the sixth month, on yimao day, Xiao Gui and others fought the Liang army west of Zhong Mountain; they met with long rains, were defeated, and Xiao Gui, Commanders Li Xiguang, Wang Jingbao, Dongfang Lao, and Army Supervisor Pei Yingqi all perished; of the soldiers who scattered and returned, only one or two in ten.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yimao day, Xiao Gui and others fought the Liang army west of Zhong Mountain; long rains fell, they were defeated, and Xiao Gui, Commanders Li Xiguang, Wang Jingbao, Dongfang Lao, and Army Supervisor Pei Yingqi all perished; of the soldiers who straggled back, only one or two in ten.

literal: On yichou day Wang Lin, Inspector of Xiang Province of Liang, presented a tame elephant.
idiomatic: On yichou day Wang Lin, Liang Inspector of Xiang Province, presented a tame elephant.

literal: That year the Three Terraces palace was expanded and repaired.
idiomatic: That year the Three Terraces palace was expanded and repaired.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jihai day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jihai day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: In the eighth month, on gengshen day, the emperor went to Jinyang.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengshen day, the emperor went to Jinyang.

literal: In the ninth month, on jiachen day, the Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiachen day, the Kumo Xi sent envoys bearing tribute.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on bingxu day, the Khitan sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingxu day, the Khitan sent envoys bearing tribute.

literal: That month 2,600 widows of Shandong were levied and assigned to soldiers; of these, one-fifth had husbands and were wrongly seized.
idiomatic: That month 2,600 widows from Shandong were levied and assigned to soldiers; one in five already had husbands and had been seized in violation of the law.

literal: That month the Wen Emperor of Zhou died.
idiomatic: That month Yuwen Tai, the Wen Emperor of Northern Zhou, died.

literal: In the eleventh month, on renzi day, an edict said:
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renzi day, an edict proclaimed:

literal: Kunlun as its pillar — thus it is called the Divine Land;
idiomatic: With Kunlun as its pillar, it is called the Divine Land;

literal: the encircling sea as its moat — thus it is called the Red County.
idiomatic: with the encircling sea as its moat, it is called the Red County.

literal: The common people have their grain; the stewards of the land are appointed for this.
idiomatic: The common people have grain to eat; stewards of the land exist for this purpose.

literal: The system of kings has changed through the ages; when the realm was carved into regions disaster followed, and at first there were twelve; when water and earth were settled, the Nine Provinces were restored.
idiomatic: The system of kings has changed through the ages; when the realm was carved into regions calamity followed, and at first there were twelve; when water and earth were settled, the Nine Provinces were restored.

literal: The Way may be complex or simple; the principle lies in suiting the times — Yin followed Xia and changed nothing.
idiomatic: The Way may be complex or simple; the principle is to suit the times—Yin followed Xia and changed nothing.

literal: Thus sun and moon are fixed in the celestial order, and kings and lords are rooted in the land — all to accord above with the dark pattern and below with rivers and mountains.
idiomatic: Thus sun and moon are fixed in the celestial order and kings and lords rooted in the land—all to accord above with heaven's pattern and below with rivers and mountains.

literal: Down to the government of Qin, which lashed the realm, abolished the feudal lords and set up commanderies — the realm became one household.
idiomatic: Down to the government of Qin, which lashed the realm, abolished the feudal lords, and set up commanderies—the realm became one household.

literal: When the Two Han inherited the foundation and Cao and Sima continued the line, the gains and losses in between are beyond full reckoning.
idiomatic: When the Two Han inherited the foundation and the houses of Cao and Sima continued the line, the gains and losses in between are beyond full reckoning.

literal: From the late Xiaochang era of Wei, repeated times of debased governance followed; salary departed from the public house, policy issued from many gates, the way of the gentry was exhausted, and the black-haired people were scorched.
idiomatic: From the late Xiaochang era of Wei, debased governance came again and again; salary departed from the public house, policy issued from many gates, the way of the gentry was exhausted, and the common people were scorched.

literal: The hosts of the Bronze Horses and Iron Shins —
idiomatic: The hosts of the Bronze Horses and Iron Shins—

literal: the bands of Black Mountain and Green Calves — ravenously spread through Jin and Zhao, boar-rushed through Yan and Qin; from this the bonds of rule collapsed and the ordinances were thrown into disorder.
idiomatic: the bands of Black Mountain and Green Calves—ravenously spread through Jin and Zhao, boar-rushed through Yan and Qin; from this the bonds of rule collapsed and the ordinances fell into disorder.

literal: This made great clans and powerful houses gather their townships, claim the cause of aiding the throne, and scheme to appoint themselves.
idiomatic: This drove great clans and powerful houses to gather their townships, claim the cause of aiding the throne, and scheme to appoint themselves.

literal: Some were princesses of the outer kin; palace women gained influence within; blinded by profit they took bribes and opened new provinces and commanderies.
idiomatic: Some were princesses of the outer kin; palace women gained influence within; blinded by profit they took bribes and opened new provinces and commanderies.

literal: Splitting large into small originally followed the needs of the time; issuing bamboo tallies and dividing seals was largely unavoidable — yet prefects, governors, magistrates, and chiefs were falsely multiplied; seeking merit and recording reality was plainly a burden, harm to public and private was a long-standing evil, it already violated the rites of governance, and there was only the waste of driving sheep.
idiomatic: Splitting large into small originally followed the needs of the time; issuing tallies and dividing seals was largely unavoidable—yet prefects, governors, magistrates, and chiefs were falsely multiplied; seeking merit and recording reality was plainly a burden, harm to public and private a long-standing evil, it already violated the rites of governance, and there was only the waste of driving sheep.

literal: Since then it has dragged on, and there has been no leisure to revise and cut back.
idiomatic: Since then it has dragged on, and there has been no leisure to revise and cut back.

literal: I reverently received the imperial succession and respectfully face the eight directions; in founding the state and ordering the realm I aim to keep things simple.
idiomatic: I reverently received the imperial succession and respectfully face the eight directions; in founding the state and ordering the realm I aim to keep things simple.

literal: I wish to still unrest and restore quiet, turn what is thin back to what is pure; where the mean is lost, reason demands correction.
idiomatic: I wish to still unrest and restore quiet, turn what is thin back to what is pure; where the mean is lost, reason demands correction.

literal: Looking at the old histories and listening to words of old: Zhou had Cheng and Kang, Han had Wen and Jing — their registered households were the greatest of antiquity and the present.
idiomatic: Looking at the old histories and listening to words of old: Zhou had Cheng and Kang, Han had Wen and Jing—their registered households were the greatest of antiquity and the present.

literal: Yet today households and mouths have dwindled from former days while prefects and magistrates are twice what they once were — this is not the way to govern custom, harmonize the winds, and show the people their measure.
idiomatic: Yet today households and mouths have dwindled from former days while prefects and magistrates are twice what they once were—this is not the way to govern custom, harmonize the winds, and show the people their measure.

literal: Moreover the Five Ridges have submitted within, the Three Rivers have turned back in allegiance; we have broadened the land and opened the frontiers, and profit reaches to the end of the Southern Sea.
idiomatic: Moreover the Five Ridges have submitted within, the Three Rivers have turned back in allegiance; we have broadened the land and opened the frontiers, and profit reaches to the end of the Southern Sea.

literal: Yet in the lands of the distant frontier there were formerly many false and inflated entries — a settlement of a hundred households would at once raise a province's name; a people of three households would vainly spread a commandery's title.
idiomatic: Yet in the distant frontier there were formerly many false and inflated entries—a settlement of a hundred households would at once raise a province's name; a people of three households would vainly spread a commandery's title.
